summary: AEON Biopharma filed an 8-K reporting it received a letter from NYSE Regulation confirming the company regained compliance with NYSE American continued listing standards, resolving prior deficiencies under Sections 1003(a)(i) and 1003(a)(ii) of the Company Guide. The .BC indicator will be removed from its trading symbol, and the company will be removed from the exchange's noncompliant issuer list. This is a routine regulatory compliance disclosure with no special-situation transaction, offer, or structural event. The filing includes forward-looking statements and confirms ongoing listing obligations.
